entities.name: Júlio Duarte Langa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Júlio Duarte Langa is a Mozambican prelate of the Catholic Church. He was bishop of Xai-Xai from 24 October 1976 until 12 July 2004. He was made a cardinal in 2015.
